description: This file defines the AgentManagerProvider class which manages the webview panel for the kilocode agent system, handles session lifecycle, process spawning, event processing, and communication between the extension and agent runtime. It includes methods for starting/stopping sessions, handling messages, managing worktrees, and integrating with VS Code APIs.

classes.name: AgentManagerProvider
classes.description: Manages the agent webview panel, session lifecycle, process handling, and communication with the agent runtime.

methods.name: buildRuntimeMessage
methods.description: Constructs a message with optional base64 images for the agent runtime extension.

methods.name: openPanel
methods.description: Opens or reveals the agent manager webview panel.

methods.name: handleSessionRenamed
methods.description: Renames session keys in internal maps when a session ID is upgraded.

methods.name: handleWorktreeSessionCreated
methods.description: Writes session ID to the worktree for session recovery.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Processes messages received from the webview panel.

methods.name: handleStartSession
methods.description: Handles starting a new session, supporting multi-version spawning.

methods.name: waitForPendingSessionToClear
methods.description: Waits until no pending session or process is active.

methods.name: initializeCurrentGitUrl
methods.description: Fetches and sets the current workspace's remote git URL.

methods.name: getWorktreeManager
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the WorktreeManager.

methods.name: getSetupScriptService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the SetupScriptService.

methods.name: runSetupScriptForWorktree
methods.description: Runs setup script for a new worktree session.

methods.name: configureSetupScript
methods.description: Opens the setup script configuration in VS Code.

methods.name: startAgentSession
methods.description: Spawns a new agent session process with given prompt and options.

methods.name: getApiConfigurationForCli
methods.description: Fetches API configuration for the agent CLI process.

methods.name: prepareWorktreeForSession
methods.description: Creates a new git worktree for parallel mode sessions.

methods.name: spawnAgentWithCommonSetup
methods.description: Spawns an agent process with standard setup, handling workspace validation and event wiring.

methods.name: handleCliEvent
methods.description: Processes events emitted from the agent CLI stdout.
